description: This Swift source file contains definitions and logic related to managing and checking the environment for the OpenClaw gateway and node versions. It includes version parsing, environment validation, command resolution, and installation procedures for the gateway component used in the OpenClaw project.

classes.name: Semver
classes.description: A helper struct for semantic versioning (major.minor.patch) comparison and parsing.

classes.name: GatewayEnvironmentKind
classes.description: An enumeration representing the various states of the gateway environment validity.

classes.name: GatewayEnvironmentStatus
classes.description: A struct encapsulating the status of the gateway environment, including version info and message.

classes.name: GatewayCommandResolution
classes.description: A struct representing the result of attempting to resolve the gateway command, including status and command array.

methods.name: Semver.parse
methods.description: Parses a raw version string into a Semver object if valid.

methods.name: Semver.compatible(with:)
methods.description: Checks if the current Semver object is compatible with the required Semver.

methods.name: GatewayEnvironment.gatewayPort()
methods.description: Determines the port used for the gateway service, checking environment, config, and defaults.

methods.name: GatewayEnvironment.expectedGatewayVersion()
methods.description: Returns the expected gateway version as a Semver if available.

methods.name: GatewayEnvironment.check()
methods.description: Performs a comprehensive check of the environment to ensure the gateway and node versions are suitable.

methods.name: GatewayEnvironment.resolveGatewayCommand()
methods.description: Resolves the command necessary to launch the gateway, considering environment and configuration.

methods.name: GatewayEnvironment.installGlobal(version:statusHandler:)
methods.description: Installs or updates the global openclaw package to a specific version asynchronously.
